prompt: Which draws an anti-aliased blue rectangle outline with a 2-pixel border?
choices: Graphics2D g2d = (Graphics2D) g; g2d.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON); g2d.setStroke(new BasicStroke(2f)); g2d.setColor(Color.BLUE); g2d.drawRect(10,10,80,50);
explanation: Enable anti-aliasing via RenderingHints, set stroke width with BasicStroke(2f), set color, then drawRect for the outline. Option A lacks stroke width control. Option C: Graphics has no setStroke method. Option D draws a filled rectangle, not an outline.
